notes.title: Patch #1 – Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re excited to roll out our latest update, packed with critical bug fixes and adjustments to improve your gameplay experience. Thank you for your continued feedback and support. Here’s what’s new:

🔧 Bug Fixes 
[list]
[*] Ogre Damage Adjustment: Resolved an issue causing ogre attacks to apply unintended damage values.
[*] Multiplayer Lobby Stability: Fixed a bug where the multiplayer lobby would become unresponsive after completing more than one match.
[*] Client-Side Health Bar Display: Addressed a visual glitch where upgrading armor did not correctly reflect changes to the health bar on the client side.
[*] Orc Worker Visuals: Updated orc worker models to properly utilize their intended textures and materials.
[*] Shaman Lightning VFX: Corrected visual effects (VFX) for the shaman’s lightning attack to ensure consistent and accurate animations.
[/list]

⚔️ Balance Changes

Shaman Lightning Attack: [list]
        [*] Reduced maximum chain range by 25%.
        [*] Damage now decays by 20% after each chain (e.g., 100% → 80% → 64% → etc.).
[/list]

As always, we appreciate your reports and encourage you to share any further issues or feedback via our official channels. Stay tuned for more updates, and happy gaming!
